entries.value: Legacy HTML5/Canvas personal portfolio site for Jarad DeLorenzo. Features: Interactive canvas animations, Box2D physics, jQuery/Modernizr, social media integration, work portfolio showcase, music section with YouTube videos. Needs: Modern framework migration, responsive design, performance optimization, content updates, security improvements.

Multi-phase website revival: Phase 1 - Analysis & Architecture (Research Agent + Site Architect), Phase 2 - Modern Framework Migration (Frontend Swarm), Phase 3 - Content & Design Refresh (Content + Design Agents), Phase 4 - Performance & Security (Optimization Swarm), Phase 5 - Deployment & Monitoring (DevOps Agent). Target: Modern React/Next.js with preserved interactive elements.

6-Phase Website Revival Plan: 1) Legacy Analysis (HTML5/Canvas/jQuery/Box2D), 2) Modern Architecture (React/Next.js), 3) Content Audit (Portfolio/Social/Media), 4) Frontend Migration (TypeScript/Responsive), 5) Performance/Security (PWA/Optimization), 6) Deployment (CI/CD/Cloud/Monitoring)

LEGACY ARCHITECTURE ANALYSIS: 1) Box2D Physics Engine (b2SpaceyDebugDraw, b2Vec2) for interactive satellite/space animations, 2) jQuery-heavy DOM manipulation and animations, 3) Custom EPC namespace with modular canvas controllers (epcSpacies, epcMusickies, epcDanglies), 4) HTML5 Canvas with multiple contexts (homecanvas, workcanvas, musiccanvas), 5) Modernizr feature detection, 6) Audio API integration, 7) Shadowbox lightbox library. MODERNIZATION NEEDS: React/Three.js for 3D, React Spring for animations, modern audio APIs, responsive canvas, TypeScript conversion.

indexOptimization: Consider periodic index rebuilding for optimal performance
